description: This script checks the startup memory usage (RSS) of a Node.js project, specifically for the 'openclaw' application. It runs various test cases, measures maximum RSS, compares against limits, and provides guidance for fixing startup memory issues.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance instructions for fixing startup memory issues based on test case and details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats an error message including guidance for resolving startup memory overages or errors.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses the maximum RSS value in MB from stderr output.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Constructs environment variables for executing benchmark/test cases.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a specific test case, checks RSS, and throws errors if limits are exceeded or errors occur.
